source_evidence.retrieval: read-only public source download; no target/Opera mutation

setActive_behavior: For each tab: aria-selected=true only for active; tabindex=0 only for active, -1 for inactive.
For each panel: remove hidden only for active; set hidden=true for inactive.
For each visual dot: toggle .is-on only for active.
If focusPanel=true, focus the newly active tabpanel.
source_click_behavior: Clicking a tab activates that tab/panel without forcing panel focus.
Clicking previous/next computes current selected tab, adds data-step -1/+1, activates the new tab/panel and focuses the new tabpanel.

source_tab_keyboard_behavior.activation: the shared keyboard helper calls tab.click() and focuses the target tab

source_initialization: current index is selected-tab index if present, else 0; setActive runs once on init
source_accessibility: tabs are role=tab with aria-controls and unique IDs
panels are role=tabpanel with aria-labelledby and tabindex=0
previous/next buttons have accessible names Előző vélemény / Következő vélemény
target_known_good_to_preserve: selected/tabindex/tabpanel relationships were present in prior rendered target DOM
ID35 provides source-like previous/next controls and suppresses duplicate numbered dot controls from AX/focus
review region and tablist accessible names are already closed
remaining_target_interaction_checks_when: ArrowRight/Left/Up/Down + Home/End move/activate tabs in source-equivalent wrapping order.
Previous/next controls wrap and focus the newly active panel as source does.
Inactive panels become hidden and active panel is exposed exactly once.
No duplicate numbered controls or decorative ordinals enter focus order.
Decorative ordinal staticText AX issue is resolved per bio-review-ordinal-accessibility-20260914-v001.json.
Visual active dot follows active tab without creating an accessible/focusable duplicate.
decision: Do not replace Atomic Tabs with source legacy JS. Use the source interaction contract only as a behavior acceptance oracle; make the smallest ID35/CSS/content correction only if a fresh target behavior check proves a specific mismatch.
